title: Road to bigger forearms: 15 inches or bust!
summary: He tapes his 13.5-inch forearms, which lag behind his 17.5-inch upper arms, and sets a 15-inch goal. His inner forearms are naturally wide but the outer forearm near the elbow is underdeveloped and becomes the focus.

claims.claim: His forearms have lagged behind his big upper arms for a long time.
He was genetically blessed with wide, muscular inner forearms, but the outer side looks close to stick forearms.
His focus is the outer/top part of the forearm that connects to the elbow; the anatomical names don't matter, only what needs to grow.
A measurement only counts with the tape tight and no slack; a loose tape is cheating, even if flexing harder gives a bigger reading.
Both forearms measure 13.5 inches against 17.5-inch upper arms; his goal is 15-inch forearms.
